title: Proof for dependents and head of household filing status
use_when: Pick this when the client must back up a claimed dependent or head of household filing status.
note: Built from IRS Forms 886-H-DEP (Rev. 10-2022) and 886-H-HOH (Rev. 10-2019), which the IRS sends in audits and which name tax years 2022 and 2019; use the year being claimed. The IRS asks for photocopies and cannot accept documents signed by a relative.

f886-h-dep.name: IRS, Form 886-H-DEP, Supporting Documents for Dependents (Rev. 10-2022)

f886-h-hoh.name: IRS, Form 886-H-HOH, Supporting Documents to Prove Head of Household Filing Status (Rev. 10-2019)

situations.dependent-child: Claiming a qualifying child as a dependent
situations.not-own-child: The child is not the client's natural or adopted child
situations.dependent-relative: Claiming a qualifying relative as a dependent
situations.non-blood-relative: Claiming a person who is not related by blood
situations.divorced-separated-parents: Divorced, legally separated or living apart from the child's other parent
situations.support: Need to show the client provided more than half of the dependent's support
situations.hoh-divorced: Head of household filer is divorced or legally separated
situations.hoh-spouse-apart: Head of household filer is married but the spouse did not live in the home during the last 6 months of the year

sections.name: Parents who are divorced, separated or living apart

items.label: Entire divorce decree, separation agreement or decree of separate maintenance
Proof that you did not live with the child's other parent for the last six months of the year
items.detail: If living apart but not divorced or legally separated.

items.label: Current custody order, completed Form 8332, or a similar statement
items.detail: More than one document may be needed.

items.label: Documents that verify your relationship to the child
items.detail: Birth certificates or other official documents of birth, marriage certificates, letter from an authorized adoption agency, letter from the authorized placement agency, or applicable court document. The IRS asks for these only for a child who is not your natural or adopted child.

items.label: School, medical, daycare or social service records showing you and the child lived at the same address for more than half of the year
items.detail: More than one document may be needed.

items.label: Letter on official letterhead from a school, medical provider, social service agency or place of worship showing names, common address and dates
Birth and marriage certificates that verify your relationship to the relative
Proof the person lived in your home for the entire 12 months of the year
items.detail: School, medical, daycare or social service records, or a letter on official letterhead from a school, medical provider, social service agency or place of worship showing names, common address and dates.

items.label: Statement of account from a child support agency
Statement from any government agency verifying the amount and type of benefits you or your dependent received for the year
Rental agreements or a statement showing the fair rental value of your residence
Utility and repair bills with canceled checks or receipts
Daycare, school, medical records or bills with canceled checks or receipts
Clothing bills with canceled checks or receipts
Entire divorce decree, separate maintenance decree or separation agreement
Documents verifying your spouse did not live with you during the last 6 months of the year
items.detail: Such as a lease agreement, utility bills, a letter from a clergy member, or a letter from social services.

sections.name: Head of household: qualifying person test

items.label: Documents that verify your relationship to the child
items.detail: Birth certificates or other official documents of birth, marriage certificates, letter from an authorized adoption agency, letter from the authorized placement agency, or applicable court document. Only for a child who is not your natural or adopted child.

items.label: School, medical, daycare or social service records showing you and the child lived together for more than half of the year
items.detail: Send as many documents as necessary.

items.label: Letter on official letterhead from a school, medical provider, social service agency or place of worship showing names, common address and dates
items.detail: If the letter is from a relative who provides daycare, at least one additional letter is required.

sections.name: Head of household: cost of keeping up a home

items.label: Rent receipts, utility bills, grocery receipts, property tax bills, mortgage interest statement, upkeep and repair bills, property insurance statement and other household bills
